B: Sure. Go straight on this street for two hundred metres.
A: OK, straight on.
B: Then turn left at the bank. The station is on your right.
A: Is it far?
B: No, it's about five minutes on foot.

passages.bodyText:

passages.title: Đi taxi ở Hà Nội
passages.bodyText: Taxis in Hanoi are cheap and easy to find. Use a taxi with a meter, or book a car on an app. App cars are often cheaper. Always tell the driver the address of your hotel. The roads are very busy from 5 to 7 p.m., so a short trip can be slow. Have small notes for the fare.

passages.title: Mua vé tàu
passages.bodyText:
A: Hello. Two tickets to Hue, please.
B: One-way or return?
A: Return, please. Is the night train cheaper than the day train?
B: Yes, it's cheaper, but it's slower. It arrives at eight in the morning.
A: OK, the night train, please. How much is it?
B: It's one million five hundred thousand dong for two return tickets.

passages.bodyText: Before you fly. You must check in two hours before an international flight. Each passenger can take one bag in the cabin (7 kg). Big suitcases must go in the hold (20 kg). You mustn't take bottles of water through security. You must show your passport and boarding pass at the gate.

passages.title: Bị cảm thì làm gì?
passages.bodyText: Do you have a cold? Here is some advice. You should rest and sleep a lot. You should drink warm water or tea with honey. You shouldn't go to the gym. Wash your hands often, and don't share cups with your family. If you have a high fever for more than three days, you should see a doctor.

passages.title: Ở hiệu thuốc
passages.bodyText:
A: Hello. Can I help you?
B: Yes. My throat hurts. Can I have something for it?
A: Try these. Take one tablet three times a day after meals.
B: Can I take them with coffee?
A: No, you shouldn't. Take them with water.
B: OK. How much are they?
A: Forty-five thousand dong.

passages.title: Cách rút tiền ATM
passages.bodyText: How to use this ATM. 1. Put your card in. 2. Choose your language. 3. Enter your PIN code. Never tell anyone your PIN. 4. Choose the amount. You can take out up to 5,000,000 VND a day. 5. Take your card and your money. The bank is open from 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday to Friday.
